content:
Nina: Starting thread for MeadowVista private deploy. Checklist: WireGuard, cross-account role, KMS alias, audit forwarding to Splunk, renewal watch.
Tom (Customer): We plan WireGuard, will open UDP 51820 tonight 23:00 UTC.
Sonal: Good. Add MTU 1420. Also ensure NAT preserves source port.
Tom (Customer): noted.
Diego: KMS: create alias alias/redwood/meadowvista and add policy granting arn:aws:iam::210987654321:role/redwood-priv-svc kms:Decrypt.
Tom (Customer): can you paste minimal policy?
Diego: Minimal policy snippet to attach to key policy: { "Effect": "Allow", "Principal": { "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::210987654321:role/redwood-priv-svc" }, "Action": ["kms:Decrypt", "kms:GenerateDataKey*"], "Resource": "*" }
Nina: Observability: Splunk index will be meadow_priv_audit; ensure S3 bucket has Object Lock OFF and CloudTrail multi-region enabled.
billing-bot: renewal-alert: usage forecast elevated; if onboarding blocked >48h tag account with `renewal-risk` and notify AMs.
Tom (Customer): I'll update here after the maintenance window and post bucket name.
onboard-bot: onboarding-status: network(pending), kms(pending), iam(pending), logs(pending). See https://redwood.internal/onboard/3447778888/status
Nina: Action items recap: 1) open UDP 51820 + set MTU 1420 (Tom) 2) create alias alias/redwood/meadowvista and attach KMS policy (Tom + Diego) 3) create cross-account role named `RedwoodPrivAccess` and share ARN (Tom) 4) confirm Splunk collector CIDRs whitelisted and S3 Object Lock off (Tom). Reconvene after window. :white_check_mark:
